liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He's Gone** (4 reviews): The He's Gone into The Other One sequence is a good one overall; Band seemed to want to drift from He's Gone into Drums, but the crowd kept them going [9][13][15][18]
- **I Know You Rider** (2 reviews): China Cat into Rider is great though relatively short; Bob repeats several lines over and over in Rider, seemingly pleased with his playing [14][15]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (2 reviews): Stranger into He's Gone into Other One forms a roughly 35-minute block mixing new and old material, called a standout; Feel Like A Stranger is also nice [10][18]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Band stayed on for The Other One before the drums; The final minute of The Other One builds a crescendo that sounds ready to return to Cryptical [13][19]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer especially loved Peggy-O [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **take a step back jam**: back after 185 archived shows (913 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-05-06.aud.morris-patch.111027.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 159 min [1]
- **gd80-05-06.senn.kaplan.6691.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 4.56/5 by 25 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is of good quality; Audience recording quality is awesome; Phil's bass tone is unusually gruff and fat throughout the recording [9][10][15]
- **gd1980-05-06.157536.senn441.senn421.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1980-05-06.sonyecm990.morris.99954.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was a Penn State sophomore as finals approached; the crowd was into it, and Rec Hall was an old college gym [14]
- Attendee recalls a party afterwards at a farmhouse out in the woods [19]
- First set was tight and typical of the Arista years, but not as strong as shows a week later at Nassau or Hartford [9]
- Reviewer considers this part of a great week of shows running through Nassau [13]
- Heard on satellite radio, reviewer calls it one of the more intense versions from after the hiatus [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-05-06.aud.morris-patch.111027.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Morris; source: Sony ECM-990 stereo mic > Cassette Master (Marantz Superscope CD320/Maxell UDXLII); Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate… [1]. Also: Tape flip in The Other One was patched with a Senn 421 source, shnid 6691; Tape flip between Drums and Space was spliced using Soundforge 9.0 [1]
- **gd80-05-06.senn.kaplan.6691.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Rob Eaton; source: Audience Recording: Sennnheiser 421 [4]
- **gd1980-05-06.157536.senn441.senn421.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441 (left + right) + (1) Sennheiser 421 (center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [5]. Also: A Nakamichi 304 source from Taylor Mason supplies a 34-second patch in Drums [5]
- **gd1980-05-06.sonyecm990.morris.99954.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Morris; transferred by Bob Morris; source: Sony ECM-990 stereo mic > Cassette Master (Marantz Superscope CD320/Maxell UDXLII) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1980-05-06 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1980-05-06-ticket/) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead of the Day: [May 6, 1980](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/05-06-1980/) [22]
